run_preprocess_audio_files: run the preprocess script to convert audio files in an input directory to H5 format
run_preprocess_with_norm_db: run the preprocess script with norm-db flag to apply audio normalization before converting to H5
create_encoded_files_dataset: create an EncodedFilesDataset from a directory of encoded audio files for music translation preprocessing
dump_to_folder_h5: dump audio files from an EncodedFilesDataset to an output folder as H5 files
filter_audio_file_paths: filter a list of file paths to only include supported audio file types like mp3, wav, flac
